import sys

data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
n = int(data[0])

time = 0
gap = 1
has_event = False
pending = {}
totals = {}
friends = set()

i = 1
for _ in range(n):
    kind = data[i].decode()
    x = int(data[i + 1])
    i += 2

    if kind == "T":
        gap = x
        continue

    if has_event:
        time += gap
    else:
        has_event = True
    gap = 1

    friends.add(x)
    if kind == "R":
        pending[x] = time
        totals.setdefault(x, 0)
    else:
        totals[x] = totals.get(x, 0) + time - pending.pop(x)

for friend in sorted(friends):
    result = -1 if friend in pending else totals.get(friend, 0)
    print(friend, result)
